description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, it and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
